name: Royal Danish Academy – Architecture, Design, Conservation
sector: institutioner inden for arkitektur og kunst
about: The Royal Danish Academy is Denmark's national school of architecture, design and conservation, based in Copenhagen. Its one English-taught first degree is not in Copenhagen: Crafts in Glass and Ceramics is taught in the glass and ceramics workshops in Nexø on Bornholm, a Baltic island reached from Copenhagen by train and ferry. The whole intake is decided by admission tests, not grades.

languageOfInstruction.note: The Academy's other bachelor programmes are taught in Danish and need Danish at A level.

sources.title: Crafts in Glass and Ceramics lasts 3 years and 3 months. The whole intake is through quota 2, with two admission tests (one online, one on the Copenhagen campus). About 16 students start each year; there were 159 applicants in 2024 and 136 in 2025.
sources.quote: Application deadline: 15 March 12:00 CET, including upload of signature page. Intake is 100% quota 2, which means that applying involves participating in two admission tests. The first is online and the second takes place on Campus Copenhagen. [...] We enroll approx. 16 students a year from all over the world. In 2024 we had 159 applicants and in 2025 the number was 136. The professional Bachelor programme in Crafts in Glass and Ceramics is a 3 year and 3 months education in the fields of glass and ceramics.

sources.title: Crafts in Glass and Ceramics is a professional bachelor programme taught in English on Bornholm.
sources.quote: The Royal Danish Academy's Programme of Crafts in Glass and Ceramics is one of Europe's leading programmes in its field. The programme is rooted in the strong Danish tradition of craftsmanship in glass and ceramics and is offered as a Professional Bachelor Programme at Bornholm

notes: The Crafts programme is taught in Nexø on Bornholm, but the second admission test and interview take place on the Academy's campus in Copenhagen.
Grades play no part in admission. The whole intake goes through quota 2, and places go to the highest scorers in two admission tests.

programmes.about: An artistic and entrepreneurial professional bachelor in glass and ceramics, taught in the workshops in Nexø on Bornholm. It lasts 3 years and 3 months, with about 16 places a year. Grades do not decide admission: an online test with a mini portfolio, then a test and interview in Copenhagen, do.

admission.capacityNote: 16 study places and one standby place. 159 applicants in 2024 and 136 in 2025.

selection.description: A mini portfolio of at most three pages of your own work, uploaded during the online test, plus five to ten everyday objects used in the test tasks.

sources.title: Admission has three steps: the optagelse.dk application, a mandatory online admission test with a three-page mini portfolio, and a mandatory test and interview in Copenhagen for the 30 to 35 highest scorers. It offers 16 places and one standby place.
sources.quote: The course of admission for the Crafts programme includes three steps: 1. An application on optagelse.dk 2. Online admission test with preparation. Mandatory. 3. Admission test in Copenhagen for invited applicants. Mandatory. Applicants with highest scores from online test will be invited for a test and an interview on Campus Copenhagen. We invite approx. 30-35 applicants. Offer of study places are granted to applicants with the highest scores after the final admission test. We offer 16 study places and 1 standby place. [...] Your mini portfolio should consist of a maximum of three pages

selection.description: Online admission test on 3 April 2027 (sign up by 18 March). The 30 to 35 highest scorers are invited to a test and interview in Copenhagen on 2 May 2027. Places go to the highest scorers after the final test.

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is a professionsbachelor programme, which the Agency names directly. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

sources.title: DP Course Results (formerly the IB Certificate) of at least 18 points, with at least grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three subjects at HL, are a qualifying examination in Denmark on the same terms as a two-year hf without overbygning: they give access to erhvervsakademi- and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2, and to a university bachelor only after two successive raises of upper-secondary subject level, at least one to A level, taken as hf-enkeltfag. Course Results under 18 points, or containing any subject at grade 1 or 2, are not a qualifying examination at all. A full IB Diploma of 24 points or more gives access to every higher education programme in Denmark.
sources.quote: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2. Ansøgere med et Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results på mindst 18 point og mindst karakteren 3 i alle fag kan derudover få adgang til en universitetsbacheloruddannelse gennem kvote 1 og 2 ved enten at supplere med enkeltfag efter samme regler som hf’erne eller tage deres IB-eksamen om for at få et IB Diploma – Retake.

sources.title: An IB counts as equivalent to a Danish stx. Apart from English B, there are no subject, level or grade-average requirements.
sources.quote: A lot of high school diplomas from EU and EØS and a number of internationally recognized exams of the type "Baccalaureat" (like IB and EB) are considered equivalent to a Danish "stx" (3-year high school), and we have no further requirements regarding contents and level of subjects apart from English at level B [...] We have no requirements as to specific subjects or subjects at certain levels or grade point average except for applicants with a vocational diploma.

requirements.label: English at B level (IB English B at SL or higher counts), or an accepted English test

sources.title: Applicants need English at Danish B level. An IB meets it with English B at SL or higher; otherwise TOEFL, IELTS Academic 6.5 or Cambridge C1/C2 at 180. No dispensation is possible.
sources.quote: Applicants for English-taught programmes at the Royal Danish Academy must have proficiency in English equal to the level English B in Danish secondary school. It is not possible to apply for a dispensation for this requirement [...] Applicants with a high school degree from Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, Iceland or an IB who have passed the equivalent of English at B-level (Danish level), must submit diploma and transcript. Applicants, who do not have the required level, must take a language test. [...] IB English B (SL) [...] IELTS Academic and online: 6.5 with a minimum score of 6,0 in each subcategory. Cambridge English C1 Advanced: 180

alternatives.label: An accepted English test instead (for example IELTS Academic 6.5)

officialWording.text: Applicants, who do not have the required level, must take a language test. [...] IELTS Academic and online: 6.5 with a minimum score of 6,0 in each subcategory. Cambridge English C1 Advanced: 180
